rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam

items.question: What eightfold attainment constitutes the root Kaula, O fair-faced goddess?
premises: The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The root Kaula is defined as the attainment of the eight powers.
uncertainties: The specific eight powers are not listed in this verse and depend on prior context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
